summary.text: Nick Collins is a Democratic state senator representing the 1st Suffolk District, in office since 2018, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
He previously served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives for the 4th Suffolk District from 2011 to 2018.

paragraphs.text: Nick Collins graduated from Boston Latin School and earned a bachelor's degree in business management from Babson College.
His professional experience includes working as a field director for Joe Biden's campaign and as a member of Senator Jack Hart's staff.
Collins served in the Massachusetts House from 2011 to 2018 before taking his Senate seat in 2018.

In the 2025-2026 session he was vice chair of the Senate Post Audit and Oversight Committee and of the Joint Committee on Economic Development and Emerging Technologies, and chair of the Joint Committee on Veterans and Federal Affairs, according to Ballotpedia.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
